business: Bin Eid Advocates and Legal Consultants
summary: A two office firm appears to lose enquiries to a free builder address, a homepage that is a 2016 article and a menu typo, just before Black Friday on 27 November.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Weebly address with the builder advert, Create your own unique website, at the bottom of every page.
findings.cost: A client choosing a lawyer for a serious matter looks for signs of a real firm, and a builder advert and free address say the opposite.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a clean footer.

findings.problem: The homepage appears to open with an article dated 2016, Things to Keep in Mind before Selecting a Law Firm, and the menu spells Legal Services as Legal Sevices.
findings.cost: A ten year old date and a typo in the menu make the firm look inactive, and a client will call the next firm on the search page.
findings.fix: A homepage that names your practice areas, and a corrected menu.

findings.problem: I found no enquiry form. Contact is by two phone numbers, a fax and an email, and the WhatsApp number appears only as text, not as a tap to chat button.
findings.cost: Clients who find you at night or on a phone cannot reach you in one tap, so the enquiry goes to a firm that makes it easier.
findings.fix: An enquiry form and a one tap WhatsApp button on every page.

redesign: Own domain, clean footer, fixed menu.
Enquiry form and one tap WhatsApp.
